description: Household electricity and gas tariffs in these markets: Belgium, Netherlands, United Kingdom, Spain. Returns the tariffs that fit the stated fuel, region, meter, contract and green needs, ranked by cost over the horizon (unit rates x yearly consumption, standing charges, supplier charges on the price card, welcome credits), each part shown, with the period the prices apply to, source link and check date. Prices are compared on one stated basis per market; parts that are the same for every supplier at an address (e.g. network charges, taxes) are named, not computed. Dynamic hourly tariffs are listed, not costed. Per market: Belgium: supplier energy cost and fixed fee incl. VAT; region Flanders, Wallonia or Brussels; gas in kWh. Netherlands: supplier delivery prices incl. energy tax and VAT; national prices (no region); gas in m³ (gas_m3), as Dutch suppliers price it. United Kingdom: all-in unit rates and standing charges incl. VAT, as on the Tariff Information Label; one of 14 regions; unit rates per kWh and standing charges per day, in GBP; Ofgem's price-cap level for the region is returned as a reference line, not an offer. Spain: energy and power terms incl. peajes y cargos, before taxes; zone (peninsula, Baleares, Canarias, Ceuta, Melilla); contracted power in kW (contracted_kw) for the power term; period_shares for three-period (P1/P2/P3) tariffs.

contracted_kw.description: ES: contracted power (potencia contratada) in kW.

existing_customer_of.description: Supplier the household is already with (unlocks existing-customer tariffs).

fuel.description: dual = electricity and gas from one supplier.

max_term_months.description: Longest fixed term accepted, in months.

night_share.description: Share of electricity used at night / off-peak, 0 to 1 (two-rate meters).

period_shares.description: ES 2.0TD: share of use in P1 (punta), P2 (llano), P3 (valle); sums to 1.

region.description: Region or city (BE: Flanders/Wallonia/Brussels; GB: one of 14 regions or a city; ES: peninsula, Baleares, Canarias, Ceuta, Melilla).

special_eligibility.description: True if the household qualifies for social or restricted tariffs.

name: compare_energy
title: Compare household energy tariffs
